body.name: exact fixed-capacity finite-chain fitted center
body.construction:
For \(p'=(\lambda',\tau',\nu')^{\mathsf T}\in(0,\infty)^3\) and \(1\leq M\leq N-1\), set \(w_{0,N}^{p'}(0)=w_{1,N}^{p',M}(0)=1\) and, for \(k\geq1\),
\[
 w_{0,N}^{p'}(k)=\prod_{j=0}^{k-1}\frac{\lambda'(N-j)}{\tau'(j+1)},
 \qquad
 w_{1,N}^{p',M}(k)=\prod_{j=0}^{k-1}
 \frac{\lambda'(N-j)}{\tau'(j+1)+\nu'\min\{j+1,M\}}.
\]
Normalize these weights to probability masses \(\rho_{0,N}^{p'}\) and \(\rho_{1,N}^{p',M}\), and define the exact finite-chain effect map
\[
 \vartheta_N(p';M)=\sum_{k=0}^N\frac{k}{N}
 \{\rho_{0,N}^{p'}(k)-\rho_{1,N}^{p',M}(k)\}.
\]
Holding the observed \(M_N\) fixed, set
\[
 \widehat\gamma_N=\frac{M_N-Na(\widehat p)}{\sqrt N},
 \qquad
 \widetilde\theta_N=\vartheta_N(\widehat p;M_N).
\]
For the diffusion-only corollary also define
\[
 \overline\theta_N=a_0(\widehat p)-a(\widehat p)
 -N^{-1/2}m_{\widehat p,\widehat\gamma_N}.
\]
